stopping_rules.rule: Exactly5 arms x48 cases,240 rows; one attempt120s, no retry/resume/replacement. Preserve partial rows on failure.

invalidation_rules: Missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; wrong values/metadata/pins; invalid counter types, overflow, allocation failures or nonzero final-live bytes invalidate panel.
A/A must match every metric; positive must differ only by +1 Product; all Projection counts1.
Require actual production binary pin, successful producer exit and canonical frozen protocol with authentic external admission.

decision_rule.text: Validate entire panel and controls, then report all per-case separate signed deltas. No weighted total or timing inference.
decision_rule.threshold: Exact signed deltas in named event dimensions
decision_rule.interval: Exact fixed-fixture values; no confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Separate signed integers; no selective weighting
